message.content:
I see - `ftyp->compatibleBrands` points into the raw data. When `avifRWDataSet` is called for a second ftyp box, it frees the old data and allocates new data. But `ftyp->compatibleBrands` still points to the old (freed) data. This is a use-after-free!
